title: WebhookDelivery.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe a webhook delivery resource.

Apple Business API 2.8+

createdDateTime.description: The date and time that the delivery was created.

deliveryState.description: The state of the delivery. Possible values: `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`.

errorMessage.description: A message that describes the error if the delivery failed.

redelivery.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the delivery is a redelivery.

request.description: Information about the request that was sent to the webhook URL.

response.description: Information about the response that the webhook URL returned.

sentDateTime.description: The date and time that the delivery was sent.
